additions: H1: Visual Studio Code 1.128 (Insiders)
Follow us on LinkedIn, X, Bluesky | Follow Insiders Changelog on X or Bluesky
Last updated: July 6, 2026
Welcome to the 1.128 Insiders release of Visual Studio Code.
These release notes cover the Insiders build of VS Code and continue to evolve as new features are added.
You can still track our progress in the Commit log and our list of Closed issues.
Add support for marking files as reviewed or unreviewed in Agent mode. #324393
Add support for line range syntax in Quick Open so you can jump to a specific line or range when opening a file. #324321
Add support for Multi-Chat in the Claude harness. #322776
Improve linkification in agent responses so links render correctly in chat and agent output. #315183
Add support for the Claude agent to access the integrated browser DOM and tools during chat. #322883
Add support for uninstalling tool-contributing extensions directly from the Tools section of the Agent Customizations window. #323509
Filter the extension marketplace list in the Tools section of Chat Customizations to only show extensions that contribute tools. #323510
